title: 第11章 莫劝他人善第12章 小爷有大师姐
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
“许三阴！”
见许三阴半晌不说话，薛长山还以为是许三阴心虚，不敢回答他，所以更加肯定，是许三阴在背后搞鬼。
“鬼叫什么？”
“本座早就说过，没去管他，是他自己争气。”
许三阴气恼的瞪着薛长山。
等决斗结束，一定要好好审问一下这小子。
按照正常的修炼速度，两三年突破一个小境界，对于废灵体来说，都算是快的，所以这个小畜生，一定有什么东西瞒着他。
“师尊，局势要逆转了。”
冷月走到许三阴身旁，低声道。
难怪敢押自己，原来是有底气的。
小瞧了这小家伙。
“恩。”
许三阴点头。
内心，忍不住激动。
之前苏凡，确实不是徐娇娇的对手，但现在脱胎大成的修为，足以碾压徐娇娇。
原本他都不抱希望，只要不输得太惨就行，可万万没想到，这小子居然给他这么大一个惊喜。
“哈哈……”
“薛长山，赶紧把黄龙丹准备好。”
许三阴大笑。
看着决斗场上的苏凡，莫名的顺眼许多。

薛长山面沉如水，喝道：“徐娇娇，你还有杀手锏，相信自己，肯定不会输给他！”
深受打击的徐娇娇，听闻薛长山此话，不由精神大振。
没错！
她还有杀手锏。
“苏凡，我不可能输给你这个废灵体！”
她一声怒吼，抬起手臂，火元素灵气，汇集于食指的指尖。
“我已领悟升龙指的真谛。”
“而你，就你这可怜的天赋，估计许长老，都没将升龙指传授给你吧！”
“毕竟就算传授给你，半个月你也无法领悟，完全就是浪费时间。”
“给我去死吧！”
随着话音落地，火元素灵气喷涌而出，如一条火红的巨龙，疯狂扑向苏凡。
压迫感十足！
“你还挺聪明的，这都能想到。”
“不过很遗憾，那老魔头后来良心发现，还是把升龙指传授给了我。”
苏凡呲牙。
许三阴脸色一黑。
小畜生，居然敢当着这么多人的面，叫他老魔头？
得意忘形了是不是？
看等下本座怎么收拾你！
“最关键，我也已经领悟升龙指的真谛！”

苏凡嘿嘿一笑。
手臂猛地抬起，天地间的灵气如潮水般涌来，隐隐伴有龙啸声。
“怎么可能？”
全场再度陷入震惊。
content_en:
"Xu Sanyin!"
Seeing that Xu Sanyin didn't speak for a long time, Xue Changshan thought that Xu Sanyin was guilty and didn't dare to answer him, so he became more certain that Xu Sanyin was behind it.
"What's the ghost's name?"
"I have already said that I didn't care about him, he just wanted to make his own success."
Xu Sanyin glared at Xue Changshan angrily.
When the duel is over, this kid must be interrogated.
According to the normal speed of cultivation, breaking through a small realm in two or three years is considered fast for a useless spirit body, so this little beast must be hiding something from him.
"Master, the situation is about to reverse."
Leng Yue walked to Xu Sanyin and whispered.
No wonder he dared to bet on himself. It turned out that he was confident.
I underestimated this little guy.
"Yeah."
Xu Sanyin nodded.
Inside, I couldn't help but feel excited.
Su Fan was indeed no match for Xu Jiaojiao before, but now his cultivation level is enough to crush Xu Jiaojiao.
Originally, he didn't have any hope, as long as he didn't lose too badly, but he never expected that this kid would give him such a big surprise.
"Haha..."
"Xue Changshan, prepare the Huanglong Pill quickly."
Xu Sanyin laughed.
Looking at Su Fan on the duel field, he felt inexplicably more pleasing to the eye.
Xue Changshan's face was as dark as water and he shouted: "Xu Jiaojiao, you still have a trump card. Believe in yourself, you will definitely not lose to him!"
Xu Jiaojiao, who was deeply shocked, couldn't help but feel refreshed after hearing Xue Changshan's words.
That's right!
She also has a trump card.
"Su Fan, there is no way I can lose to a useless spirit like you!"
She roared angrily, raised her arm, and the fire element aura gathered at the tip of her index finger.
"I have understood the true meaning of the rising dragon finger."
"And you, with your pitiful talent, I guess Elder Xu didn't even teach you the Dragon Finger!"
"After all, even if I teach it to you, you won't be able to understand it in half a month. It's a complete waste of time."
"Go to hell!"
As the words fell, the fire elemental aura spurted out, like a fiery red dragon, and rushed towards Su Fan crazily.
It’s very oppressive!
"You're quite smart, you can think of all this."
"But it's a pity that the old devil later realized his conscience and still taught me the Shenglong Finger."
Su Fan bared his teeth.
Xu Sanyin's face darkened.
Little beast, how dare you call him an old devil in front of so many people?
Are you getting carried away?
Let's see how I deal with you later!
"The most important thing is that I have also understood the true meaning of Shenglong Finger!"
Su Fan chuckled.
The arm was raised suddenly, and the spiritual energy between heaven and earth surged in like a tide, accompanied by the faint roar of a dragon.
"How is that possible?"
The whole audience was shocked again.
